syntheticData: Amakuru yose y'abarwayi muri iri gerageza ni ay'ikitegererezo.
resetConfirm: Gusiba amakuru yose y'igerageza kuri iki gikoresho? Ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
demoRoleSwitcher: Guhindura uruhare mu igerageza — si ukwinjira muri sisitemu
ruleDisclaimer: DEMO_RULE_NOT_CLINICALLY_VALIDATED — iki kimenyetso gituruka ku itegeko ry'igerageza. Imibare yaryo ni iy'agateganyo kandi ntiyemejwe n'abaganga.

SCN-01.title: Ipimwa risanzwe
SCN-01.description: Ipimwa ryakozwe n'umujyanama w'ubuzima ku kigo nderabuzima cy'igerageza Alpha-1 ritari rikeneye isuzumwa ry'umuganga.

SCN-02.title: Ipimwa ryagaragaje ikimenyetso
SCN-02.description: Ipimwa ryagaragajwe n'itegeko ry'igerageza, rifite isuzumwa ritegereje n'ikimenyetso gisobanuwe neza.

SCN-03.title: Umuganga yakuyeho ikimenyetso
SCN-03.description: Umuganga yakuyeho ikimenyetso cy'igerageza atanga impamvu; nta kohereza kwakozwe.

SCN-04.title: Kohererezwa byarengeje igihe
SCN-04.description: Kohererezwa kwateganyijwe kwarengeje itariki yagenwe (igihe cy'igerageza).

SCN-05.title: Ikurikirana ryarangiye
SCN-05.description: Ikurikirana ryarangiye rifite ibimenyetso, kandi amabwiriza yohererejwe umuturage.

SCN-06.title: Igipimo (unit) cy'isukari kibura
SCN-06.description: Ipimwa ryinjijwe n'irindi ry'agateganyo by'umujyanama w'ubuzima bibura igipimo (unit) cy'isukari.

SCN-07.title: Kohereza kabiri
SCN-07.description: Icyoherezwa kimwe cyashyizwe ku murongo kabiri gifite urufunguzo rumwe; hasigara inyandiko imwe gusa.

SCN-08.title: Guhuza nta murandasi
SCN-08.description: Amapimwa abiri yabitswe kuri telefoni nta murandasi, ategereje guhuzwa.

SCN-09.title: Kuvuguruzanya kw'inyandiko
SCN-09.description: Ivugurura ry'ikurikirana ryakozwe kuri verisiyo ishaje, rizatera amakimbirane nirihuzwa.

SCN-10.title: Uburenganzira bwakuweho
SCN-10.description: Umuturage yakuyeho uburenganzira: ibyibutsa byahagaritswe kandi ikofi ntishobora gufungura amakuru.

SCN-11.title: Kugera ku makuru y'akarere bitemewe
SCN-11.description: Umusesenguzi w'akarere k'igerageza Alpha agerageza gufungura amakuru y'akarere ka Beta akangirwa.

SCN-12.title: Imibare mito yahishwe
SCN-12.description: Umubare w'akarere k'igerageza Beta uri munsi y'imbibi z'utugari duto werekanwa nk'uhishwe.
